{{Quote|We're gonna get you some more medicine. Then you'll feel better. Okay?|Mace Towani speaks to his ill sister, Cindel|<ref name="Caravan" />}}
The '''senoti''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[New Canistel]]. The deep-rooted trees required an alkaline soil in which to grow, and produced a sap that was used for medicinal purposes. The trees were also found off New Canistel, with a small number growing wild on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. These were believed by [[Scientist/Legends|Xenoarborists]] to be survivors from two [[Canistel AgriStar]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] that were lost in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. Endor's native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] regarded the tree as holy due to its healing properties, and in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Warrick family/Legends|Warrick family]] of Ewoks used senoti sap in a medicine administered to the shipwrecked [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], [[Cindel Towani]]. Several senoti trees also grew in the [[Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden|Xenobotanical Garden]] of [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]; however, these were burnt down during the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Biology and appearance==
The senoti was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]].<ref name="Endor" /> Mature senoti had [[Color/Legends|brown]], rough, gnarled bark, and could reach a girth several times that of an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]].<ref name="Caravan" /> The trees grew deep roots and required alkaline soil in order to thrive. Senoti [[Seed/Legends|seeds]] planted in [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] soil only grew into scrubby plants, if they survived at all. The senoti produced a [[Water/Legends|watery]] sap, which had analgesic properties and could quell fevers.<ref name="Endor" />

==History==
[[File:Cindel1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Cindel Towani is nursed with senoti sap during her fever.]]
The senoti was native to [[New Canistel]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of little historic or military significance<ref name="Endor" /> located in the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}.</ref> Several [[Time/Legends|decades]] before the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], two [[Canistel AgriStar]] [[X-19 barge]]s carrying senoti seed were lost in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], a region with significant navigational anomalies. Later, several senoti trees were found on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Ewoks, a diminuitive [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species. [[Scientist/Legends|Xenoarborists]] hypothesized that one or both of AgriStar's [[Freighter/Legends|barges]] crashed on Endor, distributing the seed. Only a few of these seeds survived in the acidic soil of the moon, including one tree that grew within Ewok territory, near the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. The Ewoks soon discovered the medicinal properties of senoti sap, and the tree became regarded as a near-sacred healer,<ref name="Endor" /> used by generations of Ewoks.<ref name="Caravan" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a [[Towani family star cruiser|starship]] crashed on the moon. One of the survivors, a small [[Human/Legends|Human]] child by the name of [[Cindel Towani]], soon became ill and feverish following exposure to something in the Endorian environment. She and her brother, [[Mace Towani|Mace]], were taken in by the Ewok [[Warrick family/Legends|Warrick family]],<ref name="EGtC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> but Cindel soon lost consciousness. The Warrick family administered medicine made of senoti sap to Towani.<ref name="Endor" /> This initial dose roused Cindel from unconsciousness, but was insufficient to cure all her pain. Consequently, several of the Warricks took Mace to the senoti tree, where they extracted additional sap. Ultimately, this was enough to restore Cindel to full health.<ref name="Caravan" />

Several senoti trees could also be found on the planet [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], within the [[Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden]]. This garden was dedicated to off-world trees and shrubs, and included a grove of [[bafforr tree]]s from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], it was discovered that the [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|Vonduun crab armor]] worn by the extra-galactic invaders, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], was allergic to bafforr pollen. In order to hide this militarily significant discovery, the Garqi [[Resistance (Garqi)|Resistance]] [[Battle of Garqi|burned]] the entire Xenobotanical Garden, including the senoti trees.<ref name="Geo52">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|One tree in the primeval forest contains a special fluid which only Ewoks know. They have used it for generations to cure their ills.|[[Burl Ives]] narrates ''Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure''|<ref name="Caravan" />}}
In [[1984]], the film ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]'', written by [[George Lucas]] and directed by [[John Korty]], depicted Ewoks retrieving sap from a tree and administering it to Cindel Towani.<ref name="Caravan" /> In [[2002]], the tree was named by [[Craig Robert Carey|Craig Carey]], [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] in "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," a [[roleplaying game]] article written for [[Star Wars Gamer 9|''Star Wars Gamer'' 9]].<ref name="Endor" />
